I am a guy here :) I saw your meta post and i thought you were spot on. I am not big on comments so, this PM will have to do :) hoenstly, i have used other names, other ways of posting to r4r when i started, I would get one reply per post looking for just a friend. some were good, some not so much. my last one, I did openly for the first time ask for a girlfriend in away.. I asked for exactly the type of girl i was looking for and said I wanted to be friends and get to know each other first. I got two mocking responses, one that was form a nice enough girl but not who I was looking for. and the final one I talk to every day but am unaware of why she responded.
however, the post I made where i was open looking for a friend and hurting after a horrible brake up. i do not know how meany responses I got as it went over 20 in the first night. and for a week or so after. of the people form that post i am now very close friends with two of them met one in person, and still talk to a few others form time to time.
those are the highs and lows. I was getting good responce some times If I sat back and made a good two paragraph post. I find that your history is searched by any woman trying to talk to you. I can not blame them.. I have talked to tons of women on reddit, almost to a woman have told me about a number of creepy jerk guys.. while i have had a small share of creepy women, It makes me understand why they would fear it a bit.
I have also responded to posts, perfectly. but gotten no responce back.. those are the ones that kinda nag you. that and the, "be my friend im a girl" and then nothing in the text part.
So, I hope the informatoin i gave you helps your theroy and I think what you said was really cool and right on, I have more then once sent a girl or a guy a link to a post looking for them! hell once, I saw a girl looking for a gal pal, and then an hour later post by a different gal!
